name: accessibility
summary: Shared discipline for accessibility requirements, implementation handoff, content stewardship, rendered verification, and evidence boundaries across Design, Development, WordPress, and Verification work.
blocking_rules: Do not claim legal compliance or full accessibility conformance without scoped criteria, jurisdiction when relevant, implementation evidence, and verification limits.
Do not treat automated accessibility scans as complete evidence.
Do not claim semantic, keyboard, focus, announcement, or assistive-technology behavior from screenshots alone.
Do not silently change production code, WordPress state, content, or external systems while performing accessibility analysis.
Do not invent accessibility exceptions, legal requirements, or token replacements without source or approval.
Do not let Design, Development, WordPress, or Verification pass accessibility responsibility to another role without a concrete handoff.
